title: Cooling Coil
model_title: Chilled-Water Cooling Coil in an Air-Handling Unit Section

introduction.definition: A cooling coil cools and dehumidifies air in an air-handling unit. Chilled water (or refrigerant) flows through copper tubes bonded to thin aluminium fins. Air passing over the cold fins is cooled; where the fin surface is below the air's dew point, water vapour condenses and drains to a pan.
key_points: Face velocity ≈ 2–2.5 m/s to avoid moisture carry-over

working_principle.characteristic_curve: On a psychrometric chart the air moves towards the coil apparatus dew point; bypass factor describes air that misses the fins.

temperature.title: Air is cooled and dehumidified
temperature.description: Warm, humid air (orange) passes the coil; it is cooled (blue) and, because the fin surface is below the air's dew point, moisture condenses and drains to the pan. Coil leaving-air temperature is controlled by modulating the chilled-water valve. Face velocity is kept low (≈ 2–2.5 m/s) to avoid carrying droplets off the coil.

foundation: Mount AHU/coil sections level on a plinth or frame so the drain pan drains fully.
alignment: Seal sections air-tight; install coils in the correct air-flow direction (counter-flow to water).
piping: Pipe with isolation valves, strainer, control valve and balancing valve; trap the condensate drain with a water seal deeper than the fan static pressure.
commissioning: Vent coils, check flow and ΔT, verify valve stroke and control; check that condensate drains; balance air flow.

periodic.task: Clean coil fins; check valve operation.

overhaul.task: Replace coil if leaking or corroded.

symptoms: Water in the AHU, microbial growth

causes: Fouled fins, air in coil, low CHW flow

safety: Lock out fan before entering the AHU; clean pans to prevent Legionella/microbial growth.

script.narration: This module introduces the Cooling Coil.
A cooling coil cools and dehumidifies air in an air-handling unit.
Chilled water (or refrigerant) flows through copper tubes bonded to thin aluminium fins.
Air passing over the cold fins is cooled; where the fin surface is below the air's dew point, water vapour condenses and drains to a pan.

video_tutorials.title: Cooling Coil — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Cooling Coil.
Check drain pan and trap.
Clean coil fins; check valve operation.
Replace coil if leaking or corroded.
Watch for drain pan overflow: water in the AHU, microbial growth. Common cause: blocked drain, trap without seal.
Watch for low capacity: air too warm. Common cause: fouled fins, air in coil, low CHW flow.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
